title: Re-run vendor analysis for AWS, GitHub and MongoDB Atlas and confirm the five findings clear
description: After tasks 2-5 are done, run /refresh-vendor-ctx example-co (vendor-analyst) against aws, github and mongodb-atlas. Confirm it raises none of the five fingerprints: 8d364d28... (aws exit plan), 117e4ec1... (GitHub contract), d7ef6b05... (GitHub audit and exit), ebeb3183... (Atlas audit and exit), c42793cb... (Atlas contract). Confirm the control records sebi-cscrf-2024:GV.SC.S3, sebi-cscrf-2024:GV.SC.S4 and rbi-outsourcing-risk-directions-2025:84, 85, 86 get new observations with result satisfied or partial. Attach the observation ids as task evidence. Then run npm run validate. This is read-only analysis of workspace vendor files, with no deployment window.
acceptanceCriteria: A refresh-vendor-ctx run after task 5 is complete appends observations for aws, github and mongodb-atlas, and none of the five listed fingerprints is appended as open.

New observations exist in company-profile/example-co/soc/main.jsonl for sebi-cscrf-2024:GV.SC.S3, sebi-cscrf-2024:GV.SC.S4 and rbi-outsourcing-risk-directions-2025:84/85/86 with result other than not-satisfied.
npm run validate exits 0 after the run.

verificationMethod.description: The CISO reads the latest records in company-profile/example-co/soc/main.jsonl for the refresh-vendor-ctx run. Expected: no open finding with any of the five fingerprints and satisfied or partial observations for the five controls. No probe-* workflow covers vendor contracts, so re-probe does not apply.

rootCause.description: Five findings came from vendor-analyst reading contract fields in the vendor files. Closure needs a fresh vendor analysis showing the contract, audit-right and exit-plan gaps are gone, not just an owner saying so.
